data.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can attack twice instead of once.
data.note: Granted by Barbarian/Fighter/Monk/Paladin/Ranger at L5 (Fighter additionally at L11/L20). Each class row references this slug in its features[]; the engine gates by the referencing class's level, not by ownerSlug, so one row covers them all.

data.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can attack three times instead of once.
data.note: Fighter L11: grants a third attack per action (stacks with the L5 extra-attack grant).

data.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can attack four times instead of once.
data.note: Fighter L20: grants a fourth attack per action (stacks with L5 and L11 grants).

data.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. No score can exceed 20 with this feature.
data.note: Granted at class levels 4 / 8 / 12 / 16 / 19 for most classes (Fighter extras at 6 + 14, Rogue extra at 10). The player records each ASI's choice on character.classes[].asis (analogous to character.background.choices.asis). The engine reads those choices and synthesizes ADD stat-modifiers — same shape as background bumps, currently wired for backgrounds only; class-level ASIs land with the level-up flow's PATCH path (already in place — the level-up form writes directly to abilityScores).
